text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A meta-analysis summary reports a net positive effect of remote work on individual output, with a median of +10% for focused tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The meta-analysis summary reports a median of -4% effect of remote work on output for collaborative tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The net effect of remote work depends on the mix of focused and collaborative work in a role.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A randomized trial at Trip.com found that a hybrid schedule showed no measurable productivity difference from fully in-office peers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A field experiment on discretionary remote work found that about two remote days per week was preferred.","cited_pids":["ef88116f982d#0"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"The field experiment found that discretionary remote work helped mothers without harming non-mothers.","cited_pids":["ef88116f982d#0"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"A study of full-time remote work (five days a week) reported an association with reduced work productivity.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"A study of full-time remote work (five days a week) reported an association with higher presenteeism.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]}]}
